- [Internal Communications](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/internal-communications/): Internal comms audits, strategy playbooks and fractional comms leadership for scale-ups whose all-hands messages keep landing flat. Book a free consultation.
- [People Operations](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/people-operations/): People operations consulting for scale-ups: HRIS workflows, onboarding and policy design, and a fractional people ops partner. Book a free consultation.
- [Employee Experience](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/employee-experience/): Onboarding design, engagement surveys and employee journey mapping for scale-ups of 50 to 2,000 people, plus a fractional EX partner. Book a free consultation.
- [About us](https://themagiccoffin.com/p/about-us/): Meet Robert Stănescu, founder of The Magic Coffin: senior people and comms help for scale-ups, from internal comms to pay transparency. Book a free call.
- [Fractional HRBP](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/fractional-hrbp/): Fractional HR Business Partner for founders who need senior judgement on restructures, exits and culture, without a full-time hire. Book a free consultation.
- [Manager Enablement](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/manager-enablement/): Manager training for scale-ups: a manager kit, small peer cohorts and one-to-one coaching so new managers practise hard conversations. Book a free consultation.
- [Services](https://themagiccoffin.com/services/): Six ways into the same problem: internal comms, employee experience, people operations, fractional HRBP, pay transparency and manager enablement. Pick yours.
